verdict.rationale: AWS documents multiple official getting-started tutorials (Amplify React app, generative AI app, website hosting) and a 'six onboarding tasks' guide for beginners, plus a documented CLI install path, showing genuine zero-to-running-service quickstarts exist. However, the evidence pack never shows actual step-by-step exact commands or an explicit 'under an hour' time commitment, so the core promise of the story is only partially substantiated. Missing for 10: verbatim exact-command walkthroughs, explicit time-to-first-deploy claims, and independent confirmation that a beginner actually completes a quickstart in under an hour.
